modmenu.descriptionTranslation.voicevoxc: VOICEVOX reads the chat aloud. From the settings button on this screen, you can assign speaker IDs, view a list of speaker names, and start or stop the engine. You can adjust the volume in Minecraft’s sound settings under “Narrator/Voice”. To change the engine path or connection destination, edit the `config/voicevoxchat.json` file and click “Reload Config” on the settings screen to apply the changes.
